heading: Student's Charter
sub: The rights and responsibilities every PTI trainee can expect.
seo_title: Student's Charter — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: Pioneer Technical Institute's Student's Charter — the rights and responsibilities of every trainee during their training in Iganga, Uganda.
seo_keywords: PTI student charter, Pioneer Technical Institute student rights, vocational student responsibilities Uganda

sections.heading: What You Can Expect From PTI
list: Access to hands-on, production-unit based training in your chosen course
Instructors and department heads available for academic and welfare support
Fair, transparent assessment aligned with UBTEB/DIT standards
A safe, respectful, and inclusive training environment
Clear information about fees, timelines, and certification

sections.heading: What PTI Expects From You
list: Regular attendance and punctuality in workshop/class sessions
Respect for instructors, fellow trainees, and Institute property
Safe and responsible use of tools, equipment, and production-unit resources
Payment of fees according to the agreed schedule

sections.heading: Raising a Concern
sections.body: Any trainee with a concern about their training, welfare, or treatment should raise it with their department head in the first instance, or directly with the Director's office if unresolved.
